title: Vegan Roasted Red Pepper Pasta (GF)
description: 10-ingredient roasted red pepper pasta with a creamy, savory-sweet red pepper sauce and fresh parsley. Light, healthy, and simple, yet incredibly satisfying.

ingredients.name: Sea salt and ground black pepper ((to taste))
ingredients.raw: Sea salt and ground black pepper ((to taste))

ingredients.name: Unsweetened Original Almond Breeze Almond Milk
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 cups Unsweetened Original Almond Breeze Almond Milk

ingredients.name: cornstarch or arrowroot powder ((or other thickener of choice))
ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 Tbsp cornstarch or arrowroot powder ((or other thickener of choice))

ingredients.name: red pepper flake ((optional // for heat))
ingredients.raw: 1 pinch red pepper flake ((optional // for heat))

ingredients.name: gluten-free linguini or spaghetti noodles ((or other noodle of choice))
ingredients.raw: 12 ounces gluten-free linguini or spaghetti noodles ((or other noodle of choice))

ingredients.name: Finely chopped fresh parsley or basil
ingredients.raw: Finely chopped fresh parsley or basil

steps.text: Heat oven to 500 degrees F (260 C) and roast red {i1} on a baking sheet until charred - about 25-30 minutes. Cover in foil for 10 minutes to steam, then remove (peel away) charred skin, seeds and stems. Set aside.
Cook pasta according to package instructions; drain, toss in a touch of olive oil, cover with a towel and set aside.

While the red {i1} are roasting, bring a large skillet over medium heat and sauté shallot and {i4} in {i2} until golden brown and soft - about 4-5 minutes. Season with a generous pinch of salt and pepper and stir. Remove from heat and set aside.
Transfer sautéed shallot and {i4} to blender with roasted {i1}, {i6}, {i9}, {i7} and cornstarch. Season with desired amount of salt, pepper, and red pepper flake.

Blend until creamy and smooth, taste and adjust seasonings as needed, adding more salt and pepper or {i7} for flavor. You want the flavor to be pretty robust and strong since {i10} don't have much flavor - so be generous with your seasonings.
Once blended, place sauce back in the skillet over medium heat to thicken. Once it reaches a simmer, reduce heat to low and continue simmering.

Once sauce is thickened to desired consistency (see photo), add {i10}. However, before tossing add a touch more olive oil, salt and pepper to the un-tossed noodles for added flavor. Then, toss to coat.
Serve with (generous amounts of) vegan parmesan, {i9}, and fresh chopped parsley or basil.
